Alex Winger (Japanese: アレックス・ウィンガー, Hepburn: Arekkusu Wingā) is a video game character from Capcom's Street Fighter series of fighting games.
Balrog, known in Japan as Mike Bison (Japanese: マイク・バイソン, Hepburn: Maiku Baison), is a fictional character in Capcom's Street Fighter series.
Birdie (Japanese: バーディー, Hepburn: Bādī) is a character in the Street Fighter series.
Blanka ( ; Japanese: ブランカ), also known by his birth name Jimmy, is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.

Cammy White (Japanese: キャミィ・ホワイト, Hepburn: Kyamī Howaito), also known by the codename Killer Bee (キラービー, Kirā Bī), is a fictional character in the Street Fighter fighting game series created by Capcom.
Captain Commando (Japanese: キャプテンコマンドー, Hepburn: Kyaputen Komandō) is a mascot character created by Capcom's North American branch to advertise their Nintendo Entertainment System games.
Kenzo Sawada, commonly known as Captain Sawada, is a character in the 1994 film Street Fighter.

Charlie Nash (Japanese: チャーリー・ナッシュ, romanized: Chārī Nasshu), known as Nash in Japan and as Charlie in early international releases, is a fictional character in Capcom's Street Fighter series of fighting games.
Chun-Li ( ; Japanese: 春麗(チュンリー), Hepburn: Chun-Lee) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter video game series.
Dan Hibiki (Japanese: 火引 弾, Hepburn: Hibiki Dan) is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game franchise.
Dee Jay (Japanese: ディージェイ, Hepburn: Dī Jei) is a fictional character in the Street Fighter series.
Dhalsim ( ; Japanese: ダルシム, Hepburn: Darushimu) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter series.
Dudley (Japanese: ダッドリー, Hepburn: Daddorī) is a fictional character in Capcom's Street Fighter video game series.
Edmond Honda (Japanese: エドモンド 本田), better known as E. Honda, is a character created by Capcom for the Street Fighter fighting game series.
El Fuerte (Japanese: エル・フォルテ) is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter franchise.
Elena (Japanese: エレナ) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series who made her first appearance in Street Fighter III: New Generation in 1997.
F.A.N.G (ファン, Fan) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter series.
Gill (Japanese: ギル, Hepburn: Giru) is a character in the Street Fighter series of video games by Capcom, first appearing in Street Fighter III: New Generation.
Guile (Japanese: ガイル, Hepburn: Gairu) is a fictional character from Capcom's Street Fighter series of fighting games.
Ibuki (いぶき, Ibuki) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter series, first appearing in the 1997 fighting game Street Fighter III: New Generation.
Ingrid (Japanese: イングリッド, Hepburn: Inguriddo) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter series.
Juri Han (Korean: 한주리) is a character in the Street Fighter series.
Ken Masters (Japanese: ケン・マスターズ, Hepburn: Ken Masutāzu) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.
Kimberly Jackson (Japanese: キンバリー・ジャクソン, Hepburn: Kinbarī Jakuson) is a character in the Street Fighter series, first introduced in Street Fighter 6.

Laura Matsuda (Japanese: ララ マツダ/松田) is a fictional character from the Street Fighter series of video games, making her first appearance in 2016's Street Fighter V. She is the sister of Sean Matsuda, a character from 1997's Street Fighter III. She is from Brazil, and much like fellow Brazilian character Blanka, she utilizes electricity in some of her attacks.

Luke Sullivan (Japanese: ルーク・サリバン, Hepburn: Rūku Sariban) is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series, first introduced in the 2016 video game Street Fighter V as the final downloadable content from 2021.
M. Bison, known in Japan as Vega (Japanese: ベガ, Hepburn: Bega), is a character and the main antagonist of the Street Fighter series created by Capcom.

Mai Shiranui (Japanese: 不知火舞, Hepburn: Shiranui Mai; alternatively written しらぬい まい) is a character in the Fatal Fury and The King of Fighters series of fighting games by SNK. Introduced in 1992's Fatal Fury 2, the character was originally conceived as a male character named "Ninja Master", but when a request was put in to include a female character in the game they revised the concept entirely.
Makoto (Japanese: まこと) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series, designed by Keigo Chimoto and first appearing in 1999's Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike.

Mike Haggar (マイク・ハガー, Maiku Hagā), also known mononymously as Haggar, is a character in the Street Fighter shared universe, mainly playable in the Final Fight and Saturday Night Slam Masters series of video games.
Necro (Japanese: ネクロ, Hepburn: Nekuro) is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.
Oro (Japanese: オロ) is a fictional character in the Street Fighter series of fighting games by Capcom.
Poison (Japanese: ポイズン) is a character in Capcom's Final Fight and Street Fighter series of video games.
Q is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.
Rainbow Mika (レインボー ミカ), also known as R. Mika or Mika Nanakawa (七川 美華), is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.
Remy (レミー, Remī) is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.
Rufus (Japanese: ルーファス, Hepburn: Rūfasu) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter series of fighting games.
Ryu ( ; Japanese: リュウ, Hepburn: Ryū) is the protagonist of the video game series Street Fighter by Capcom.
Sagat (Japanese: サガット, Hepburn: Sagatto) is a character from the Japanese fighting game series Street Fighter, created by Capcom.
Sakura Kasugano (春日野 さくら, Kasugano Sakura) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter series.
Sean Matsuda (Japanese: ショーン・マツダ, Hepburn: Shōn Matsuda) is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series.
Seth (Japanese: セス, Hepburn: Sesu) is a character in Capcom's Street Fighter  fighting game series.
Sheng Long is a character hoax related to the Street Fighter series, created by Electronic Gaming Monthly as an April Fools' prank in 1992.
Sodom (Japanese: ソドム, Hepburn: Sodomu) is a fictional character from both the Final Fight and Street Fighter series of video games.
Thunder Hawk (Japanese: サンダーホーク), commonly referred to as T. Hawk, is a character from Capcom's Street Fighter fighting game series, introduced in Super Street Fighter II in 1993.

Terry Bogard (Japanese: テリー・ボガード, Hepburn: Terī Bogādo) is a character and the protagonist of the Fatal Fury series created by SNK. Introduced in Fatal Fury: King of Fighters (1991), he is an American fighter who enters the worldwide "The King of Fighters" tournaments to combat his adopted father's murderer, Geese Howard.
Tifa Lockhart (Japanese: ティファ・ロックハート, Hepburn: Tifa Rokkuhāto) is a character from the 1997 role-playing video game Final Fantasy VII by Square (now Square Enix).
Twelve (トゥエルヴ, Tueruvu) is a character from the Street Fighter fighting game series.
Vega, also known as Balrog (Japanese: バルログ, Hepburn: Barurogu) in Japan, is a character from the Street Fighter fighting game series by Capcom.
Yun (ユン) and Yang (ヤン, Yan) are a pair of fictional characters appearing in the Street Fighter fighting game series.
Zangief ( ; Japanese: ザンギエフ) is a fictional character in Capcom's Street Fighter series.
